Question Statement/Data:

The Heights (cm) were measured for 20 people of different ages. A researcher is interested to know the
following information of the data.

    1.   Mean
    2.   Range
    3.   Standard deviation
    4.   Skewness
    5.   Kurtosis

  Respondents        Heights (cm)            Age

          1                   150            26
          2                   220            50
          3                   138            45
          4                   145            47
          5                   162            65
          6                   142            46
          7                   120            21
          8                   136            44
          9                   118            53
         10                   128            29
         11                   120            21
         12                   132            56
         13                   140            59
         14                   110            22
         15                   128            42
         16                   130            48
         17                   135            49
         18                   114            17
         19                   114            20
         20                   124            19

Solution:

Interpret:
Two Variables were given in this question;
But Main variable is Height(cm).

Explain:
Mean=sum of all values/total Numbers

BadarToor.Com

Range is the difference between greatest and lowest value.
Std. Deviation is the positive square root of variance.
Skewness is the data distribution shape is positively skewed.
Kurtosis is the sharpness of the peak of a frequency-distribution curve.
Comment:
The value of kurtosis is positive. So it is leptokurtic.
Answers:
Mean=135.30
Range=110
Std. Deviation=23.908
Skewness=2.486
Kurtosis=8.197
